description.en: The ID of the lightweight database instance.

description.zh:
指定的轻量数据库实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用[ListRegions](~~189315~~)查看支持的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The ID of the region where the lightweight database instance is located. You can call [ListRegions](~~189315~~) to query the most recent region list.

title.zh: 查看轻量数据库实例的参数信息

descriptions.zh: 如果您需要查看轻量数据库实例的参数的具体信息，可通过此接口查询。
descriptions.en: This operation retrieves the parameter details of a lightweight database instance.
